projectSummary: A third independent statement that the architecture of this muscle is not settled in the primary literature. Carried as a boundary on how categorically the muscle page may describe internal structure.

publication.statusSource: Crossref REST API works record plus the Crossref/Retraction Watch CSV export, both fetched 2026-09-13

study.intervention: Three-dimensional cadaveric modelling of muscle and tendon architecture.
study.population: Eleven formalin-embalmed cadaveric specimens were examined: five (2 male, 3 female) were serially dissected, digitised and modelled in three dimensions, and six (4 male, 2 female) were dissected.

title: Three-dimensional study of pectoralis major muscle and tendon architecture.
